title: Psalm 99: The Holy King Enthroned on the Cherubim
summary: The LORD reigns from Zion, enthroned above the cherubim, and the nations are called to tremble and praise his great and awesome name. He is a King who loves justice and has done justice in Israel. The psalm remembers Moses, Aaron, and Samuel, who called on him and were answered, and it describes him as a God who forgave his people and still dealt with their wrongdoing. Three times it declares that he is holy.

from.where: The Study Bible's notes on Psalm 47
from.text: It is one of the enthronement psalms, a group (usually 47, 93, and 95 to 99) that celebrate the LORD as king.

line: The LORD reigns from Zion, a King who loves justice; he answered Moses, Aaron and Samuel, forgave and still dealt with wrong, and three times the psalm says that he is holy.
guide: Ask whether you approach God casually or as the holy King; the psalm holds both, he is holy and he answers. Ask who prays for you as Moses and Samuel prayed for their people, and whom you are praying for.

stanzas.title: The LORD reigns from Zion over the peoples: He is holy
The King who loves justice: He is holy
Moses, Aaron, and Samuel called, and he answered: the LORD is holy

verses.t: The LORD reigns; let the nations tremble! He is enthroned above the cherubim; let the earth quake!
Great is the LORD in Zion; He is exalted above all the peoples.
Let them praise Your great and awesome name— He is holy!
The mighty King loves justice. You have established equity; You have exercised justice and righteousness in Jacob.
Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at His footstool; He is holy!
Moses and Aaron were among His priests; Samuel was among those who called on His name. They called to the LORD and He answered.
He spoke to them from the pillar of cloud; they kept His decrees and the statutes He gave them.
O LORD our God, You answered them. You were a forgiving God to them, yet an avenger of their misdeeds.
Exalt the LORD our God and worship at His holy mountain, for the LORD our God is holy.
